fixed_scope: Global fixed 10/20-m schedules at 0.4/1/2/4 s; taxonomy generalization and policy rejection remain active. Regional static schedules, if separately derived, must not claim native runtime.
policy_scope: Illustrative application policies, not empirical privacy calibration. Every method receives identical hard rules.
predeclared_factor: Only local temporal freshness differs between control and local400; all spatial maxima are 20 m.
privacy_scope: Operational track/category support and hard-policy fulfillment only; no formal or empirical privacy-gain claim.
runtime_scope: Unpaced native subprocess wall time and native processing_ms, excluding movement generation, Python audits and report writing; not a real-time deadline guarantee.
source_scope: Two complete unchanged correction source streams; horizon recorded per source. Selective suppression OFF, no motion regeneration or source selection.
strategy_scope: Temporal First preserves temporal accuracy; Spatial First preserves spatial accuracy. Semantic First uses Temporal First secondary. Every adaptive method releases when its policy is satisfied.
